frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS theme variables and dark mode definitions applying consistent color tokens and base styles.

frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: Allows exporting and importing backups with file handling and a confirmation dialog before restoring data.
frontend/src/components/settings/LogoutC: Logout card with confirmation dialog that clears local data and triggers logout even if server deletion fails.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Renders a settings card for browser notification preferences with permission handling, category toggles, and test notification support.
frontend/src/components/settings/Profile: Provides an editable display name field with validation and save/cancel actions inside a settings card.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: Displays a slider and numeric input to adjust the target attendance percentage.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Allows selecting light/dark/system theme modes and choosing a color variant.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: Shows a confirmation dialog for destructive actions with customizable title, description, and action label.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu offering edit, reset, and delete actions for a subject.

frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: Error boundary that classifies auth errors and displays session-expired or generic recovery UIs.
frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Animated splash screen showing the app logo with theme-aware icon selection during initial loading.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Triggers a toast notification when an error occurs and dismisses when handled.

frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Defines core domain types for subjects, events, stats, timetable, exchanges, settings, user profiles, and default app state.

frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining theme variables, dark mode, animations, and component styling.

frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Defines branding constants and helpers returning theme‑aware logo asset paths.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions for class merging, IDs, date formatting, day checks, and color selection.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.

frontend/src/notifications/reminderFailu: Produces rate‑limited user‑friendly messages for reminder notification failures.

frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings view for editing profile, managing notifications, themes, targets, backups, and handling a resilient logout flow.
frontend/src/pages/StatsPage.tsx: Page summarizing overall attendance with a progress indicator and breakdown of attended, missed, and cancelled classes.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Subject-level stats page with edit, reset, delete actions and calculations for safe bunks and required classes.

frontend/src/rank/RankingService.ts: Provides cached and authenticated fetching of rankings plus point submission via the repository.
frontend/src/rank/RankPage.tsx: Loads actor and user context, passing them to RankingScreen as the ranking module entry point.
